name: Gästehaus Antonius
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated with panoramic mountain views in Berwang, Gaestehaus Antonius is a welcoming retreat for outdoor adventurers. Well-appointed rooms featuring timber furnishings provide restful comfort after active days.

Berwang ski lifts, scenic hiking trails, and cross-country tracks are just steps away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Antonius in Berwang offers cosy accommodations and alpine serenity in the Tiroler Zugspitz Arena.
